Maya (AE): Heads-up — Cobalt Dynamics POC is blocked. Customer needs a 10k TPS demo for checkout flow tomorrow and they want a short note on KMS/BYOK. Also unclear on burst pricing. Can we prioritize?
Sam (Eng): Which API/endpoint are they hitting and what's the tenant id? I can try a short trial pool if ops will allow burst.
Maya (AE): They're using hosted text-generate-v1 (us-west). Tenant: cobalt-dyn-tenant-42. Load script is a simple loop hitting /v1/streams. Pasting snippet: ```bash
for i in 1..1000; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"text-generate-v1","input":"price check"}' &
done
wait
```
Sam (Eng): Thanks. Checking pool usage now. @ops-bot can we raise burst to 4x for cobalt-dyn-tenant-42 for ~6h?
ops-bot: Capacity check: us-west GPU pool at 62% utilization. Burst available: 1 spare node. Enabling x4 would require temporary extra capacity or reserved Dedicated. To request: `/ops-request enable-burst <tenant> <multiplier> <hours>`.
Ana (PS): I can run a profiling run to validate latency at target TPS. Note: cache warm-up and KV behavior will affect p95 on first 1–2 minutes — recommend steady ramp.
Lina (Finance): Pricing note — short-term burst add-on lists at +30% of unit rate. For strategic deals we can approve a one-off 15% promo if AE + RevOps confirm ARR expectations. @Maya (AE) send estimated token volumes ASAP.
Ethan (Security): Security Q on KMS/BYOK: hosted product does NOT support customer-managed keys today. BYOK is supported on Dedicated/Private. For demo they can use Redwood-managed KMS with Transit encryption. @Maya (AE) did customer say BYOK is mandatory for the demo?
Maya (AE): They said BYOK is mandatory in prod only. For tomorrow's demo they're ok with Redwood-managed KMS if we provide a written statement in the security questionnaire.
Devon (CTO): Ok — prioritize this. @Sam (Eng) coordinate with ops and post ETA. I'm comfortable approving temporary burst trial + 15% promo for the demo window. Ensure security statement added to the questionnaire and PS runs a perf test before customer-facing demo.
Sam (Eng): Copy. If ops approves, I can enable a trial scale within ~45 min and run a 20‑minute perf sweep. Will report p50/p95 and error rate.
ops-bot: Ops request created by Sam (Eng): REQ-8421 — enable-burst cobalt-dyn-tenant-42 multiplier=4 duration=6h. Track: https://internal.ops/requests/REQ-8421
Maya (AE): Thanks team — I'll update Cobalt Dynamics: "We will enable a temporary trial burst for the demo, finance approved a limited promo, and security will provide a written statement confirming Redwood-managed KMS for the demo." :thumbsup: 
Sam (Eng): Posting results in this thread once perf sweep completes.
Ana (PS): I'll schedule the profiling run and capture logs for the security questionnaire.
Devon (CTO): Good. Keep me in the loop if ops hits capacity constraints or if customer insists on BYOK pre-demo.
